_comment: Cold-start fallback per-spec runtimes (SECONDS) for the FULL (k3d cluster) target. MUST stay separate from shard-weights.json: a full spec provisions a real sandbox pod, so these run ~3x the fast suite's numbers and balancing full shards on that table starves one shard. Weights are a MAX, never a mean — an under-weighted spec is what overloads a shard. Why: PR #675.
